fields.observer_id: ship/station/device whose sensor knowledge is being updated
fields.origin_position_au: 3-element XYZ vector in the materialized system reference frame
fields.filters: non-empty list of signature types or ['all']
fields.priority: optional preferred signature type; improves its detection without excluding other selected filters
fields.scan_duration_s: positive duration; longer scans have diminishing returns

rule: The console builds this request. The detection engine resolves it against already-materialized world state.
